name: Bee Hotel
description: Hotel/B&B booking suite for Drupal built on BAT and Drupal Commerce: bookable unit nodes, availability, dynamic per-night pricing via a Price Alterator plugin chain, cart/checkout, guest messaging, a vertical availability calendar and iCal export.
project_description: BEE Hotel is the Drupal platform for hotels, B&Bs and lodging: a direct booking engine with dynamic rates and availability, a daily operations planner, guest-messaging tools and an integrated PMS (BAT) plus Drupal Commerce. It lets a property take direct reservations (single or multiple occupants), calculate per-night prices with granular control via the Price Alterator plugin system, maintain weekly base-price tables per unit, run a vertical availability calendar for daily management, generate a daily arrivals/departures report, export availability as iCal to Google Calendar / Airbnb / Booking.com, and provide personalised guest post-sale stay pages. The suite ships eleven submodules covering utilities, the price-alterator base and concrete alterators, the vertical calendar, add-to-cart, iCal export, daily-report emails, a sample-hotel installer and upgrade helpers.
